status: WHAT-IF ONLY (candidate 36 variant B): 3 oz (105 um finished) outer copper on the JLC041622-7628 stack. JLC does not offer it on 4 layers (capabilities page 2026-10-15).
source_of_truth: Native-21's single layer-stack source (stage 33 refactor, c33-six-layer/REFACTOR-PROOF.md). prototype-closure/pcb/build_native21.py writes the board's (layers) copper entries and (setup (stackup ...)) from it; native-21/layout/layers21.py exports CU / OUTER / INNER / KICAD_ID / T_UM / Z_MM / ADJ / PLANE_ROLE from it for the layout scripts, gates and physics models. 'layers' is the KiCad stackup, top to bottom; copper entries add kicad_id (KiCad 9/10 numbering: F.Cu 0, B.Cu 2, InN.Cu 2 + 2N) and z_mm.
z_mm_definition: Copper-centre depth below the top copper surface (top of F.Cu), mm; solder masks excluded. layers21.py recomputes it from the thicknesses (sum of everything above plus half the copper) and asserts the value stated here; the computed value is the one used, so the physics keeps the arithmetic of the former sheet_solver.LAYER_Z_MM table bit for bit.

plane_roles._comment: net -> the inner copper layer that carries the net's reference / return plane (copper.json zones on In1 / In2, stage 31). n_ls also has a small heat-spread pour on In2 (U42); its plane is In1.
